concept.name: DDD Tactical Patterns
concept.tagline: DDD Tactical Patterns: practical patterns, trade-offs, and failure modes for production engineering teams.

spark.summary: DDD Tactical Patterns is a foundational topic in System Architecture & Design. Engineers use it to make predictable trade-offs under load, failure, and evolving requirements.
spark.keyTakeaway: Adopt DDD Tactical Patterns when its operational assumptions match your scale, consistency needs, and team skills.

concept.whyItMatters: DDD Tactical Patterns influences reliability, cost, and delivery speed. Misapplying it creates outages, data bugs, or unmaintainable systems.
whenToUse: Production systems where DDD Tactical Patterns addresses a recurring bottleneck or risk

deepDive.markdownContent:
## DDD Tactical Patterns

This deep dive walks through when to apply **DDD Tactical Patterns**, how it interacts with adjacent patterns, and which signals prove it is working in production.

### Operating checklist

- Define success metrics and failure budgets.
- Validate behavior under partial outages.
- Keep runbooks and diagrams current for on-call engineers.

caseStudy.problem: Repeated incidents traced to gaps in DDD Tactical Patterns practices
caseStudy.solution: Standardized DDD Tactical Patterns with explicit invariants, dashboards, and game-day exercises
caseStudy.impact: Lower MTTR and fewer customer-impacting regressions
